panel.name: workspace_panel
panel.string: Arrange your windows, then save the current workspace.
Preview: [APPLIED] windows applied; [ADJUSTED] adjusted to fit; [SKIPPED] skipped.
Preview: [APPLIED] applied; [ADJUSTED] adjusted; [SKIPPED] skipped. Some Inventory folders are unavailable or filtered. Try again after Inventory loads.
Preview: [APPLIED] applied; [ADJUSTED] adjusted; [SKIPPED] skipped. Nearby chat kept its current presentation.
Preview: [APPLIED] applied; [ADJUSTED] adjusted; [SKIPPED] skipped. Windows with attached utility windows were left alone.
That workspace is damaged or uses an unsupported version. Its saved definition was kept.
Use a unique name of up to 64 letters, numbers, spaces, dashes, underscores or periods. Maximum: 32 workspaces.
Wait for Inventory to load before saving its folders. Your existing workspaces were kept.
Close some extra Inventory windows before saving. Maximum: 16 additional windows.
A workspace with that name already exists.
Workspace saved. Click OK to keep it; Cancel restores your previous arrangement.
Workspace renamed. Click OK to keep the change.
Workspace deleted. Click OK to keep the change.

panel.name: workspace_editor
panel.text: Save viewport, bars, Inventory, maps, compatible chat geometry, and the Received Items panel size. Preferences and the workspace switcher are excluded.

combo_box.name: workspace_combo
combo_box.tool_tip: Workspaces are stored separately for each account.

check_box.name: workspace_remember_folders
check_box.label: Remember Inventory folders
check_box.tool_tip: For this save: restore single-folder roots and view modes, or a selected folder in All Items. Search filters and item selections are not saved.

button.label: Add workspace inventory window
button.name: workspace_add_inventory
button.tool_tip: Open one extra inventory window managed by workspaces. All open additional Inventory windows are also saved.

panel.text: Tabbed Conversations saves size and position only. Inventory folders are optional; search filters, item selections and inventory contents are never saved.
Changes preview immediately. Preferences OK keeps them; Cancel restores them.
